profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record is tagged with the operator name CenturyLink, the legacy brand of the telecommunications company now operating as Lumen Technologies, which formally renamed itself in September 2020. Its coordinates fall in the Sunrise area of Las Vegas, Clark County, Nevada, near Sandra Road, but this registry could not confidently match it to a specific street address: an area aggregator listing for Las Vegas found three genuine, currently Lumen-branded facilities in the metro (Lumen Las Vegas 1 at 1 Aerojet Way North, Lumen Las Vegas 2 at 4485 East Sahara Avenue, and Lumen Las Vegas 3 at 3944 East Silvestri Lane) and no facility listed under the older CenturyLink name at all, but none of the three could be matched to this record's own coordinates with any confidence. Rather than guess which, if any, of the three this record represents, this entry documents the ambiguity honestly and leaves the specific building unidentified. CenturyLink/Lumen's Las Vegas presence traces back through a long chain of legacy telecom mergers (US West, Qwest, Embarq, and others were absorbed into what became CenturyLink before the 2020 Lumen rebrand), and buildings still tagged with the older name in mapping data typically represent either an outdated tag on a real, still-operating Lumen facility or a legacy central-office/telephone-exchange building rather than a purpose-built colocation data center; this record could plausibly be either, and no evidence located this session resolves which. Nevada was not among the 20 states Lumen divested to Brightspeed in its 2022 sale of legacy CenturyLink local telephone assets to Apollo Global Management, a deal covering states such as Missouri, Georgia, and North Carolina but explicitly leaving Lumen operating directly under the CenturyLink brand in a set of western states that includes Nevada, consistent with this rows retained CenturyLink operator tag.
